gates.description: resolveTitleAt resolves speaker titles as-of a meeting date, including the Monterey Park mayor-rotation fixture
Search-corpus matcher is behavior-identical to the pre-refactor loop, and cached values (search corpus, sitemap catalog) survive unstable_cache's JSON round trip
No transaction-requiring Prisma op (upsert/createMany/updateMany/nested write/$transaction) on the HTTP-backed default client
Canonical transcript URLs never redirect, and every non-canonical spelling redirects to a canonical one
Cut-off transcript links ("…", "...") are matched to the meetings they could mean
MomentCard picks the innermost agenda item covering ?t= and the topic pages covering it
The collapsed Upcoming list shows the soonest meeting plus the next regular council meeting
Percent-encoded unreserved characters (%2D, %5F, …) redirect to the canonical cached URL; canonical paths, including legitimately encoded ones, never redirect
Unknown cities, topics and meetings are answered from the cached catalog without a Neon query; known ones never 404; the city refresh reaches topic detail pages
Home page shows city cards with correct content and layout
City pages render with correct content and meeting cards
